messages:
elaine: Quick proposal — run a 6-week remediation sprint pilot for postmortem actions. Owners get one sprint to triage and a second sprint to close medium/low items; P0s stay on an accelerated track. Weekly 30m sync + async tracker updates.

matt: +1. Also propose a 'pattern backlog' for recurring incidents and a monthly heatmap review so we don't keep re-fixing the same failure modes.

sasha: Day 0 incident -> owner assigned within 24h -> create triage card with ETA -> weekly check-ins (Tue 10:00) -> close or push to next sprint. Keep SLAs simple.

jamal: Can we automate reminders? @ops-bot can you schedule 3-day-before-ETA reminders and escalate on overdue?

ops-bot: Scheduled: reminder job created. Will post to #eng-oncall 3 days prior to action ETAs and escalate to oncall if overdue >48h. Use `/remind owners` to adjust.

elaine: Minimal timeline template for postmortems (drop into the doc):

```
- Detection: 2026-03-12 14:03 UTC
- Mitigation: rollback service-x v2.3 -> v2.2 (14:07)
- Root cause hypothesis: queue overflow on encoded-batch path
- Verification: load test + canary (owner: sasha, ETA: 2026-03-19)
- Actions:
  - patch backpressure (owner: jamal, ETA: 2026-03-26, status: in-progress)
  - add metric alert (owner: matt, ETA: 2026-03-15, status: done)
```

matt: Every action should include a fallback owner and a closure reviewer (someone who signs off on verification). Avoid single-person blackholes.

sasha: Rotation suggestion: 6-week Incident Commander rotation with a 1-week overlap handoff so ICs can shadow and transfer context.

jamal: Add a 'closure window' policy: actions older than 60 days must be escalated to Eng Manager + PM with a written rationale or be re-triaged into the pattern backlog.

elaine: Ops play: we'll create a remediation sprintboard at `boards.redwood/team-remediations`. Labels: P0/P1/P2, pattern, verification-needed. Pilot for 6 weeks.

matt: Define metrics: median time-to-close, percent actions overdue, and recurring-mode incident count. Monthly report to reliability council.

sasha: I'll spin up the first sprintboard and post the link here by EOD. I'll also run a 15m retro after pilot week 2 to adjust cadence.

elaine: Owners for the pilot: jamal -> backpressure patch, matt -> metric-alert followups, sasha -> verification + canary. Tagging PMs for pattern review after sprint 2. :thumbsup:
